entities.summary: David Harrower is a Scottish playwright who lives in Glasgow. Harrower has published over 10 original works, as well as numerous translations and adaptations. David Harrower was a poets & playwrights from Edinburgh (b. 1966-09-01, Edinburgh). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
